owner_request: ревью на grok 4.7, 1 или 2 прохода, на твое усмотрение

findings.summary: The explain JSON shape types only the first element of each list, so later step detail objects are outside the freeze.
findings.failure_scenario: Changing the detail keys on the contribution or authority step leaves explain.json and this test green, because the stored shape is the empty detail of the prepare step.

findings.summary: The type-map cross-check compares each fixture target to that same row's fqcn and only requires a non-empty note on reported rows.
findings.failure_scenario: A reported target can be any other string, and a type-map target or phase change leaves the test green; the notes already say P3 for AssignmentScopePhase and InvalidCommandInput while target-map.json schedules both moves in P2.

findings.summary: The doctor and reserved-prefix snapshots call CrmWorld::seed() and their afterEach only runs CrmWorld::resetRuntime().
findings.failure_scenario: After those tests, Carbon::now() stays 2026-10-06 and Relation still maps crm.user to the CRM user for later tests in the same process; ResourcesSnapshotTest.php:113 does the same.

findings.summary: Writer mode overwrites the fixture and the assertion then reads that write back, with no check that packages/ still matches commit 09612160.
findings.failure_scenario: AZGUARD_BASELINE_WRITE=1 on a tree whose production code has already moved rewrites the I17 JSON and the snapshot tests pass; CommandsSnapshotTest.php:277 rewrites commands.json the same way.

findings.summary: absent_at_070 omits the P3 generated migration pattern <date>_create_azguard_<storage>_audit_log.php from knowledge/identities.
findings.failure_scenario: Adding that filename from an existing command leaves every recorded absent_at_070 flag false and the resources snapshot stays green.
